measurement: THE COST LIMB — head fit on seed 47 (all 300), evaluated on seed 21's FULL 300. Zero shared signatures. n = 300 problems.
BOTH_LIMBS_AGAIN: more problems solved AND cheaper, on 300 problems with a 2.2-point SE. This is the objective's first limb met at a size where the interval means something.

THE_THREE_MEASUREMENTS_OF_ONE_EFFECT.reading: the two CROSS-RUN measurements agree closely (+12.0, +13.0) and the same-run one is inflated (+21.4). DIRECTION OF TRANSFER IS SYMMETRIC -- it does not matter which set trains and which evaluates. The carried number is +12 to +13 points; +21.4 is what training on adjacent tasks buys and it is printed only as that.

the_agreement_invariance_check_is_much_c.agreement: 121 of 300 = 40.3%; G changed the pick on 179
the_agreement_invariance_check_is_much_c.reading: at n=75 the agreement group moved +2 and then -2 and I could only call that noise. At n=300 it moves -1 of 121. The effect is entirely in the disagreements, and the temperature confound is now bounded at about a third of one episode per hundred.

a_control_that_behaved_differently_and_I.observed: on the seed-47 head fit, the n=100 control scored 45.3% against the full head's 42.7% -- ABOVE it. On the seed-21 fit it was 41.3% against 56.0%, below.
a_control_that_behaved_differently_and_I.what_it_probably_is: my fit runs a fixed 400 iterations at a fixed learning rate, and the gradient is averaged over the pool, so a larger pool takes SMALLER effective steps. n=100 beating the full fit is consistent with under-convergence rather than with a signal that needs no examples.
a_control_that_behaved_differently_and_I.consequence: the n=100 control is not interpretable on this fit and I am not reading it as evidence either way. PCA-8 (29.3% vs 42.7%) still does its job, and the permutation control (16.0-22.7%) still collapses to chance.

bounds: n = 300, SE 2.2 and 2.7. One model, one layer, one grammar, two seeds.

The head's own pick accuracy on seed 47's held-out quarter was 42.7% against an agent at 20.0% -- and the agent's 20.0% there is AT CHANCE, lower than the 33.3% on seed 21's held-out quarter. The two quarters are not equally hard for the agent.
v3's failures are localisation-bound. On a repair-bound set this head would be expected to do nothing, which is what v2 measured.
